de: A resident of Shebekin, Belgorod region, received a shrapnel wound to his hip after detonating an FPV drone in the yard of an apartment building. The victim was hospitalized, according to the regional operational headquarters.

te: Social Fund simplified the appointment of a single allowance to families from the border
de: Families temporarily resettled from the border regions of Russia will be able to issue a single allowance under simplified rules. The new terms of payment were explained in the Social Fund of the Russian Federation.

te: “Friend and brother”: Mozambique President spoke about relations with Russia at a meeting with Putin
de: Mozambique President Daniel Shapu called Russia a friend and brotherly country during a meeting with Russian leader Vladimir Putin. He also confirmed the republic’s intention to develop cooperation with Moscow in a wide range of areas.

te: Torpedo beat SKA for the fifth time in a row in the regular championship of the KHL
de: Nizhny Novgorod Torpedo won the fifth consecutive victory over the St. Petersburg SKA in the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). The guest meeting of the regular championship ended with a score of 4: 3.

te: In Sevastopol lifted restrictions on electricity supply
de: In Sevastopol, it was allowed to connect all consumers to the electricity grid. The corresponding command was given by the dispatcher of the power system on October 26 at 19:10, Sevastopoleneergo reports.

te: Peskov jokingly asked at the pool in the Kremlin, whether they are still alive
de: Russian presidential spokesman Dmitry Peskov jokingly asked if the journalists who continue to work in the Kremlin late at night were still alive. This was told by the correspondent of the Kremlin pool Alexander Yunashev in his Telegram channel.

d: В Кремле пока не объявили сроки нового раунда переговоров России, США и Украины по мирному урегулированию. Пресс-секретарь президента РФ Дмитрий Песков заявил РИА «Новости», что информацию о дате встречи предоставят своевременно.
te: The Kremlin promised to timely inform the date of new negotiations on Ukraine
de: The Kremlin has not yet announced the timing of a new round of talks between Russia, the United States and Ukraine on a peaceful settlement. Press Secretary of the President of the Russian Federation Dmitry Peskov told RIA Novosti that information about the date of the meeting will be provided in a timely manner.

de: Compliment about appearance brought to tears participant of the British reality show “Big Brother” Lynx Noumey. The man admitted that he suffers from dysmorphophobia and painfully perceives even harmless remarks about his body. That's what The Sun says.
